acceptance.output_evidence: Confirm words: 'This records, once, that the final commentary for this ticket was sent, under your name and the time you confirm. It cannot be undone. Nothing is sent by this: it only records that you sent it.' Buttons: 'Record that the final commentary was sent', then 'Yes, record it (cannot be undone)' and 'Cancel'. Refusals: wrong type 'Nothing was recorded: this ticket is not an analysis request, so there is no final commentary to record on it.'; no draft 'Nothing was recorded: this ticket has no draft commentary, so there is no final commentary to have sent. Wait for the draft, then try again.'; already recorded 'Nothing more was recorded: the sending of the final commentary is already recorded on this ticket. The list is refreshing and will show who recorded it and when.'; changed 'Nothing was recorded: the ticket changed while you were looking at it. Reload the page, check the ticket, and press again only if the final commentary has been sent.'; 404 'Nothing was recorded: this ticket was not found among the tickets you may act on. Reload the page and check that you are signed in to the right firm.'; 403 'Nothing was recorded: you are not permitted to record this. Ask an Opal team member who is permitted to record it.'; fallback 'The request did not complete, so it is not known whether the sending was recorded. Reload the page and check the ticket before you press again.' git diff --stat origin/DEV HEAD (portal): 4 files changed, 336 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-).
acceptance.status_reason: Judgment criterion: the oracle is 3.0.0_SA_CVO at L9; the worker records output and gives no verdict.
